# Oru ERP

> The cloud enterprise resource planning (ERP) operating system designed for modern Indian enterprises, regional businesses in Kashmir and Jammu & Kashmir, and high-growth service agencies worldwide. Engineered by Easyio Technologies.

## System Overview

- **Platform Name:** Oru ERP
- **Official Domain:** https://oruerp.com
- **Parent Technology Agency:** Easyio Technologies (https://easyio.tech)
- **Chief Technology Officer & Lead Architect:** Burhan Ali (CTO, Easyio Technologies)
- **Primary Markets:** Kashmir Valley (Srinagar, Rangreth, Lassipora), Jammu & Kashmir industrial corridors (Bari Brahmana, Samba, Gangyal), Pan-India SMEs, and global digital agencies.
- **Default Currency & Locale:** Indian Rupee (₹, INR), Lakhs and Crores formatting (en-IN), Indian Financial Year (April 1 – March 31).

## Core Capabilities & Architecture

- **Sub-100ms Reaction Times:** Optimistic client-side caching, non-blocking UI rendering, and low-latency synchronization tailored for variable network environments.
- **Automated Indian GST & Compliance:** Automated CGST/SGST and UT-GST splitting, real-time GSTIN validation, single-click E-Invoicing (IRN), E-Way Bill generation, and input tax credit (ITC) reconciliation.
- **Agency Operations & Profitability:** Milestone and retainer billing, billable utilization tracking, team workload heatmaps, and authenticated self-service client portals.
- **Statutory Payroll & HRMS:** Form 16 generation, Provident Fund (PF) ECR, Employee State Insurance (ESI), Professional Tax, and automated payslip dispatches.
- **Enterprise Security:** Strict multi-tenant row-level security (RLS), immutable audit trails, and role-based access control (RBAC).
